title: Compositional transport on constant generators
statement: Let S,P,U,V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], s:P to S, h:U to P, v:V to U, F a sheaf on S and L its constructed inverse image [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For any A in Type (u+1) and tau:C_P(A) to L_s(F), with C constant sheafification [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], let gamma be [def-weil-pbc-etale-set-constant-pullback-comparison] and c [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. Set xi_h=gamma_h inverse followed by L_h(tau) followed by c_{s,h,F}. For every etale W over U and e in A, c_{h composed with s,v,F} sends the v-unit pullback of xi_h(eta_U(e)|W) to xi_{v composed with h}(eta_V(e)|W base changed to V), followed by the associativity transport from L_{(v composed with h) composed with s}(F) to L_{v composed with (h composed with s)}(F). No invertibility of tau is assumed.

source.place: Tags 03CB, 03CC (inverse-image composition), 0B65 (comparison of adjoints), 03P5 (constant sheaves), and 0A3H final paragraph (equal-valued generators)

proof.text: The unit equation defining gamma_h sends pulled constant generators to equal-valued generators. Check at the terminal object by the composed adjunction, then restrict to arbitrary W by naturality. Both comparisons for v after h have the same composite unit equation. Injectivity under the composite adjunction and the sheafification universal property identify them.

Whisker this equality with tau and move tau past the unit by naturality. Associativity of c pastes c_{s,h} and c_{h composed with s,v} with c_{h,v} and c_{s,v composed with h}. Evaluate at W base changed to V and its constant generator e. The associativity transport has the displayed direction. This reasoning also applies to empty A and empty/disconnected schemes.

theorem etaleSetConstantTransportGenerators
    (S P U V : Scheme.{u}) (s : P ⟶ S) (h : U ⟶ P) (v : V ⟶ U)
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (A : Type (u + 1))
    (τ : (constantSheaf P.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).obj A ⟶
      (Scheme.etaleSetPullback s).obj F) (W : U.Etale) (e : A) :
    (((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2)
      S U V (h ≫ s) v).hom.app F).hom.app
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).obj W))
      (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v) (Type (u + 1))
        (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
        (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (h ≫ s)).obj F)).hom.app (op W)
        (((etaleSetConstantPullbackComparison h).inv.app A ≫
          (Scheme.etaleSetPullback h).map τ ≫
          ((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2)
            S P U s h).hom.app F).hom.app (op W)
          ((toSheafify U.smallEtaleTopology
            ((Functor.const U.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj A)).app (op W) e))) =
      (((etaleSetConstantPullbackComparison (v ≫ h)).inv.app A ≫
        (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (v ≫ h)).map τ ≫
        ((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2)
          S P V s (v ≫ h)).hom.app F ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun k : V ⟶ S ↦ (Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj F)
          (Category.assoc v h s))).hom.app
            (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).obj W)))
        ((toSheafify V.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const V.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj A)).app
            (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ v).obj W)) e)
